heading, The complete healthcare management platform, level 1

Whether you're running a single clinic or operating across multiple sites, Semble puts one connected platform at the core of your business. Clinicians get faster workflows. Leaders get the visibility to grow. And as AI becomes part of how healthcare works, Semble is the infrastructure that makes it work for you.
end of link, See how it works
Over 16,000 healthcare professionals across 80 specialities rely on Semble every day
heading, Healthcare is complex, your systems shouldn’t be, level 2

Spend less time clicking between systems and more time treating patients. Semble unites your tools, team and data together in a single platform. Reclaim time that should be spent on patient care. Semble is the care orchestration platform for private healthcare.

A complete practice management system: it’s in our DNA

Admin and ops work never sits still, it jumps between calendars, invoices, reminders, and compliance checklists. Semble makes the everyday easy, so your team can book, bill and report with ease while chasing less. Run your day-to-day operations in one place, with clinical confidence.
end of tabpanel, Practice management system
An electronic health record (EHR) that helps treat, not just record

Providing care for people means more than filling out records. Semble’s EHR gives clinicians one place to consult, treat, prescribe and follow up. Use AI-powered notes and structured templates to capture every note, result and conversation along the way for quality care. Spend more time with patients, not paperwork.
end of tabpanel, Electronic health record
Automation that works the way you work

Admin tasks don’t just live in one system and neither does Semble. Connect to over 1,200 external business tools including CRM, business intelligence, HR and more so your everyday admin, reminders, and communications are handled automatically, no matter where they happen. Build workflows that reflect how your teams work, not how software expects them to. No more manual workarounds, just a platform that scales as you scale.
heading, Treat more patients, do less admin, level 2

Healthcare demand isn't slowing down and those keeping pace are the ones who've stopped letting admin get in the way. Semble customers report fewer missed appointments, faster clinical workflows, reduced administrative burden and more patients seen – improving outcomes without adding complexity.

heading, Deliver the care your patients deserve, level 2

Semble helps you focus on what matters most, your patients. Care that is responsive, seamless and provides a consumer-grade digital experience. Whether you're treating, supporting or managing care, Semble removes the weight of admin, lack of coordination and outdated workflows.
And as patient expectations evolve, understanding what they want from their care experience has never been more important. Learn more in "From AI curiosity to connected care".

heading, Everything you need to grow, level 2

Most EHRs are just digital filing cabinets: they store patient data, but don’t let you use it when and where it matters. That's why Semble is open and flexible, built for clinics of every size whether you're a solo practitioner, group practice or enterprise business.
Semble is the last practice management system you'll ever need.
